quirks.summary: Portal URL and vendor come from PlanIt's directory; neither the vendor nor any retrieval step has been verified against this portal.
quirks.detail: PlanIt reports scraper_type 'Atrium'. That label is a hint, not a finding - it is recorded elsewhere in this skill as stale at one authority and wrong at another. Fingerprint the portal before choosing a recipe, and set portal.vendor_verified when you have.
quirks.workaround: Run the vendor detection signatures in vendors.json against the portal before applying any recipe.

quirks.summary: The Atrium application is not mounted at the site root; /Search/Results and the anti-forgery token are under a path prefix.
quirks.detail: Recipe A's endpoints are written root-relative and they 404, or the search page carries no __RequestVerificationToken. Sampled 2026-09-16. The mount path is a per-install fact and is not yet recorded here.
quirks.workaround: Open the register in a browser, note the path the search form posts to, and record it in endpoints.search.

verification.note: Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 200; redirected to https://planning.bridgend.gov.uk/Disclaimer?returnUrl=%2Fsearch%2FPlanning%2FAdvanced%2F/; vendor confirmed by fingerprint (def-atrium)
Recipe A from the site root: no __RequestVerificationToken on the home/search page
